name: video_upscale
description: Upscale video via Topaz or Magnific. Not HDR — use `video_hdr`. Pass `creationIdentifier` or Freepik `videoUrl`. Params: `video_upscale_models_list`. Then call `creations_show`.

astraCreativity.description: Topaz Astra 2 only: 0-1, how much new detail to invent. Defaults to 0.5.

astraPrompt.description: Topaz Astra 2 only (enhancementModel "astra2"): style guidance for the generated detail. Setting it caps the source clip at 18s (less above 24fps: the real limit is 450 input frames), so leave it empty for longer videos.

astraRealism.description: Topaz Astra 2 only: 0-1, stylized to photoreal.

astraSharp.description: Topaz Astra 2 only: 0-1 pre-enhance sharpness. 0 blurs, 0.5 passes through, 1 sharpens.

auto.description: Topaz only, optional: how the filter values are applied.

creationIdentifier.description: Completed owned video identifier. Required without `videoUrl`.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.

preview.description: Magnific/Precision preview: upscales and bills only the first 12 frames. A longer source is cut server-side; send the whole clip.

proResOutput.description: Magnific/Precision: also emit ProRes 422 HQ master (.mov). Ignored on preview.

targetResolution.description: Output width 640-3840. Required on Magnific/Precision; on Topaz it is optional and overrides `upscaleFactor`.

upscaleFactor.description: Topaz only, required: 1-8. Multiplies the source width when no `targetResolution` is sent; the result must not exceed 3840px.
